meta.title: Data corrections log
meta.rule: Every change Takwimu makes to a published value, label or citation that is not already a resolved case in data/conflicts.json is logged here with the original and corrected figure, the reason, the evidence (source and page), the date and the pages affected. scripts/test-corrections.js compares every value with the previous release's data (git main) and fails the build if a changed value has no entry here or in the register. Errors in the source documents themselves are not our corrections: they are flagged on the records (source_error) and flagged where the value is shown. Each correction is footnoted beside the value it changed, from its was and note fields.

entries.original: 53.8 per cent, cited to the county chapter's department table total, Controller of Budget FY 2022/23 report PDF p. 583 (printed p. 557)
entries.corrected: 53.8 per cent (unchanged), cited to Table 2.4, Siaya row, Controller of Budget FY 2022/23 report PDF p. 34 (printed p. 8)

entries.note: The figure is printed in Table 2.4 (PDF p. 34); the department table has no total row. Value unchanged.

entries.measure: Pending bills, stock at 30 June 2022 (FY 2021/22 report, key observations)
entries.original: KSh 789.96 million, CoB FY 2021/22 report PDF p. 407 (printed p. 383)
entries.corrected: KSh 705.38 million, CoB FY 2021/22 report PDF p. 416 (printed p. 392)
entries.reason: The 789.96 is in section 3.37.13, the key observations for Samburu County, which end on PDF p. 407 just before Siaya's chapter begins. Siaya's own key observations (section 3.38.13) give 705.38, the same as Table 3.251. Found while re-examining the ledger's open cases against the documents.
entries.evidence: cob-report-2021-22, PDF p. 407: "3.37.13 Key Observations and Recommendations ... 2. High level of pending bills which amounted to Kshs.789.96 million" (Samburu); PDF p. 416: "3.38.13 ... 3. High level of pending bills which amounted to Kshs.705.38 million as of 30th June 2022"
entries.note: That figure was Samburu County's; Siaya's own key observations give 705.38.

entries.measure: Wage bill, FY 2016/17 and FY 2017/18 (FY 2017/18 report, key observations)
entries.original: KSh 1,120 million (FY 2016/17) and KSh 1,580 million (FY 2017/18), CoB FY 2017/18 report PDF p. 268 (printed p. 247)
entries.corrected: KSh 2,400 million (FY 2016/17) and KSh 2,310 million (FY 2017/18) as printed, CoB FY 2017/18 report PDF p. 274 (printed p. 253), with a source-error flag
entries.reason: The 1.12 and 1.58 billion are in section 3.37.9, Samburu County's key observations, above the heading "3.38 Siaya County" on the same page. Siaya's own key observations (section 3.38.9) give 2.4 and 2.31 billion; that sentence calls the fall an increase of 3.9 per cent, so its two figures appear swapped, which is flagged as an error in the source and both are kept as printed.
entries.evidence: cob-report-2017-18, PDF p. 268: "3.37.9 Key Observations ... 3. High wage bill that has increased by 40.8 per cent from Kshs.1.12 billion in FY 2016/17 to Kshs.1.58 billion" then "3.38 Siaya County"; PDF p. 274: "6. High wage bill that has increased by 3.9 per cent from Kshs.2.4 billion in FY 2016/17 to Kshs.2.31 billion during the period under review"
entries.note: That figure was Samburu County's; Siaya's own key observations print this one.

entries.evidence: cob-report-2018-19, PDF p. 268: "3.37.9 Key Observations ... A high wage bill that increased by 25.3 per cent from Kshs.1.58 billion" (tables above it are headed Samburu County); PDF p. 274: "3.
